description:
Configure a product with options and get pricing. Call first without options to see available options, then call again with selected options.

NOTE: This tool uses "productCode" as parameter name. When placing an order with placeOrder, the same code goes in products[].code — different parameter name, same value.

IMPORTANT — How options work:
- Numeric options (width, height, amount): send {code, value} e.g. {code:"width", value:2000}
- Radio/selection options (finishing, material): send ONLY the child code WITHOUT value, e.g. {code:"finishing-all-sides"} — do NOT send the parent code
- The response shows a tree with parent groups containing children. Use the CHILD code directly, never the parent code.

IMPORTANT — File upload requirement:
- If the response contains upload:true on a product, that product REQUIRES a print file — you CANNOT place the order without one.
- Fix/stock items (upload:false or upload absent) do NOT require files and can be ordered immediately.
- For products that require files, use one of these approaches in placeOrder:
  Option A (easiest): add uploader:true to the product → Probo returns a upload URL in the order response, upload the file there
  Option B (direct): add files:[{uri:"https://publicly-accessible-url.pdf"}] to the product → order queued immediately

Example flow for a configuration product that requires files:
1. configureProduct({productCode:"banner-510"}) → see all options
2. configureProduct({productCode:"banner-510", options:[{code:"width",value:1000},{code:"height",value:1000},{code:"amount",value:1},{code:"finishing-all-sides"}]}) → check if upload:true
3a. placeOrder with uploader:true → {code:"banner-510", options:[...], uploader:true} → upload file to returned URL
3b. OR placeOrder with direct file → {code:"banner-510", options:[...], files:[{uri:"https://..."}]}

address.description: Delivery address for shipping cost calculation

options.description: Flat array of options. Numeric: {code,value}. Radio/selection: {code} only (use child code, NOT parent)

name: configureProduct
